scope.limits: Bounded search of accessible relevant collections; not an exhaustive search of every CyVerse account, local disk or project. Missing from inspected exports does not mean raw imagery is lost or BRDF impossible.
scope.available: Orthomosaics, terrain, GCP/mission-plan files, reports, filename/time/software CSVs and sky photographs. Photogrammetric camera calibration and sky photographs alone do not establish radiometric calibration or irradiance stability.
scope.unresolved: Original raw image archive and Metashape .psx/.files or machine-readable pose/intrinsic exports; overlap targets; panel/DLS records; true acquisition date/timezone; original terrain and angle-generation units/provenance.
